question: Oda-san, in the cover for chapter 862, Shanks has Hanafuda cards! A "Shikou" (kanji is four light)! ... "Just a Yonko (kanji is four stars)"!! -
answer: Nooo you noticed that- amazing! Yes, that hand in Hanafuda is called a "Shikou (kanji for four light)." It is read as "Shikou," but it does seem to suggest Shanks's future as one of the Yonko. Well done.
name: Shinboku-kun
